findings.message: Constant "OrderColumns" is file-local and should be camelCase ("orderColumns"). const already signals immutability, so casing signals scope instead: PascalCase means the value crosses files, camelCase means this file made it. A PascalCase local sends the reader looking for an import that is not there.
